channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: U.S. Commerce Dept. Inquiry Into Megaspeed Was Halted After Nvidia Intervention
item.description: An investigation into Megaspeed, a Singapore company that was buying advanced Nvidia A.I. chips, was transferred to the Justice Department after a top Nvidia executive reached out to Commerce Department officials.

item.title: NPR: Thick smog shrouds New Delhi after Diwali firecrackers add to seasonal pollution
item.description: New Delhi, home to over 30 million people, regularly ranks among the world's most polluted areas during winter, with pollution worsening in late October and November.

item.title: BBC News: Russell Brand sentenced to 10-and-a-half years in prison for rape and sexual assault
item.description: The disgraced entertainer was sentenced on Monday following a four-week trial at Southwark Crown Court.

item.title: The Guardian: ‘I didn’t dance until I was 45’: how Jorge Drexler went from repressed doctor to rump-shaking Oscar-winner
item.description: How did a Uruguayan medic who grew up under an anti-music dictatorship win a best song Academy award? As he looks set to scoop up more prizes at the Latin Grammys, we meet the extraordinary Jorge Drexler It makes sense t…

item.title: Al Jazeera: US agencies unite to combat rogue drone threats nationwide
item.description: More than $40bn allocated by NATO for counter-drone technologies as US agencies ramp up measures against aerial threats.

item.title: Ars Technica: Vulnerability that lets hackers SSH into Linux devices is under active exploitation
item.description: "*sshole" poses a serious threat to Internet security.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: Welcome to Weed Island
item.description: How the tiny, self-governing British island of Jersey unintentionally became Europe’s front line in the multibillion-dollar global cannabis industry.

item.title: WIRED Science: Scientists May Have Discovered a Massive Starless Galaxy
item.description: The promising candidate contains roughly 2 billion times the sun’s mass in hydrogen, yet appears to have no stars. Studying it could help answer questions that have vexed astronomers for years.

item.title: WIRED Business: Jensen Huang Hired a PR Firm Known for Handling Sex Scandals Last Year
item.description: The Nvidia CEO began working with consultants from Heller as early as October 2025, around the same time he was first linked to a suspected Chinese spy.

item.title: The New Yorker: The Unfinished Business of American Socialism
item.description: The movement has often seen its ideas flourish as its organizations withered. Will today’s resurgence follow the same course?
